description:
Electric Scooter with Seat – Your reliable partner for daily commutes and short trips!

This Electric Scooter for Adults with Seat & Rear Rack combines comfort, power, and portability. Equipped with a 350W brushless motor, it reaches 19MPH and offers a 16–28 mile range on a single charge with 4–5 hour fast charging.

The 5-level shock absorption, soft seat, and rear rack ensure a smooth and practical ride, while the 65 ft bright headlight enhances safety at night. Weighing only 34 lbs, it folds in just 3 seconds, making it perfect for commuting, shopping, or leisure rides. A great choice for adults seeking a lightweight, comfortable, and dependable transportation solution.

Electric Scooter with Seat and basket

⚡ 1. Efficient Motor & Extended Range

Equipped with a 350W high-efficiency brushless motor, this e-scooter reaches speeds up to 19MPH and covers 16–28 miles per charge. The 36V 5.2Ah rechargeable battery delivers consistent power and supports 4–5 hours fast charging, perfect for daily commutes or short trips.

💺 2. Comfort-Focused Design

Ride comfortably with the ergonomic seat, rear shock absorbers, and 5X advanced damping system that minimizes bumps on uneven roads. Ideal for both city streets and suburban paths.

🔦 3. Safety and Visibility

Featuring a 65-foot ultra-bright LED headlight, rear reflectors, and durable frame, this scooter keeps you safe day or night. The dual braking system ensures responsive stopping power even on slopes.

🧳 4. Lightweight & Foldable Convenience

The 34 lbs aluminum frame supports riders up to 265 lbs, and the 3-second folding design allows easy storage in a car trunk or under a desk. Take it anywhere with minimal effort.

🧠 5. Smart Control & Practical Utility

Switch between 4 speed modes to match your ride — from eco to sport. The rear cargo rack lets you carry your essentials effortlessly, making it the perfect travel companion for shopping, commuting, or leisure rides.
